name: notion-build-my-engineering-wiki
description: Build a personalized Notion engineering home from technical docs, project context, and chat or connected sources. Use to get started with an engineering wiki and a clear view of current work.

name: notion-create-my-team-handbook
description: Create a team handbook in Notion from scattered processes, team documents, requests, and chat context. Make procedures easy to find, show who maintains them, and track related requests.

name: notion-database-designer
description: Turns scattered notes and recurring work into useful Notion trackers for requests, content plans, or team work. Use to set up or improve a tracker, choosing its fields and views from the user's needs; ordinary record updates belong to the task's workflow.

name: notion-knowledge-capture
description: Captures conversations and supplied notes as Notion wiki pages, how-to guides, FAQs, decision records, or retrospectives. Use when saving or updating durable knowledge from existing context; use research-documentation when new source discovery and synthesis is the main task.

name: notion-meeting-prep
description: Prepares meeting agendas, internal pre-reads, and decision briefs using Notion context and relevant research. Use for preparing the next or upcoming meeting, meeting preparation, recurring meeting context, or updating meeting outcomes; use knowledge-capture for a standalone record of an existing discussion.

name: notion-organize-my-semester
description: Organize a semester in Notion from course notes, syllabi, assignments, and chat context. Use when getting organized for a course or semester to keep notes clear and upcoming work easy to find.

name: notion-plan-marketing-campaigns
description: Organize campaign briefs, content ideas, and production work in Notion. Use when planning a marketing campaign, building a content calendar, or tracking content production.

name: notion-research-documentation
description: Researches questions across Notion sources and synthesizes cited briefs, comparisons, or reports. Use when answering requires discovering and reconciling workspace information, optionally with external research, and returning or saving the findings.

name: notion-set-up-my-project
description: Create a useful initial Notion project home with tasks, docs, and meeting notes, then work with the user to confirm the team and choose a Projects database. Use when starting or organizing a project in Notion; routine task edits, status reports, and implementing a technical spec are separate workflows.

name: notion-setup
description: Set up Notion so your agents can remember your preferences, find your work, and pick up where you left off.

name: notion-spec-to-implementation
description: Converts Notion product or technical specs into implementation plans, linked tasks, and evidence-based progress updates. Use for planning or implementing a spec, creating tasks from requirements, or reconciling implementation with spec changes.

name: notion-weekly-project-digest
description: Produces evidence-based weekly project or team updates by comparing reporting periods, tasks, decisions, and blockers in Notion. Use for recurring status digests; use spec-to-implementation for requirement-level implementation tracking.

name: auth-guide
description: Guide to setting up third-party authentication for a Notion Worker. Covers brokered credentials for external-service API keys / personal access tokens, OAuth, and plaintext environment secrets only when worker code needs the value. Use when the worker needs credentials for a non-Notion API, not for Notion API tokens or `ntn login`.
user-invocable: false

name: custom-blocks
description: Build interactive UI inside Notion connected to workspace data. Covers creating, modifying, and troubleshooting custom blocks from project setup through deployment.
user-invocable: false

name: sync-debug
description: Diagnose a failing or misbehaving sync — fetch run logs, identify errors, cross-reference with code, and suggest fixes
user-invocable: true
disable-model-invocation: true
allowed-tools: ["Read", "Bash", "Glob", "Grep", "Edit", "Write"]

name: sync-guide
description: Comprehensive guide to building Notion Workers syncs — covers the two-sync architecture (backfill+delta), replace mode, pagination, consistency buffers, pacers, deletion strategies, and common pitfalls. Auto-loads when sync-related work is detected.
user-invocable: false

name: sync-validate
description: Review a sync capability for common bugs — cursor advancement, pagination termination, state persistence, bi-modal correctness, consistency buffers, and deletion handling
user-invocable: true
disable-model-invocation: true
allowed-tools: ["Read", "Glob", "Grep", "Bash"]

name: sync
description: Scaffold a new sync capability with guided setup — asks about data source, mode, pagination, and cursor design, then generates working code
user-invocable: true
disable-model-invocation: true
allowed-tools: ["Read", "Edit", "Write", "Bash", "Glob", "Grep", "Agent"]
